signtweaks.name: SignTweaks
message.signtweaks.installCloth: Install Cloth Config API to access mod options
message.signtweaks.configScreenDisabled: Config screen is not available on this version.
option.signtweaks.general.useEnhancedEdi: Whether enhanced editing should be enabled when opening the sign editor.
option.signtweaks.general.showEditorTogg: Whether to show a button to toggle enhanced editing.
option.signtweaks.general.showActionButt: Whether to show the quick action buttons in the sign editor.
option.signtweaks.general.actionButtonsC: Whether clicking the quick action buttons should close the sign editor.
option.signtweaks.general.showLineBreakI: Whether to show a symbol where a line is broken manually rather than automatically.
Whether to block input from keybind keys that are held down when opening the sign editor, until the keys are released.
option.signtweaks.general.revertOnEscape: Whether to revert the sign content when exiting by pressing the '%s' key rather than clicking the '%s' button.
Additional condition to open the sign editor when right-clicking.
option.signtweaks.general.clickThrough.t: Whether to click through signs placed on block entities when not sneaking.
option.signtweaks.autoFill.useAutoFill.t: Whether to automatically insert text and then close the sign editor when placing a sign.
option.signtweaks.autoFill.autoFillLines: The lines of text to insert when AutoFill is in use.
option.signtweaks.autoFill.useCopiedLine:
Click to set the AutoFill Lines to the text copied from a sign.
To save the result, this will close the config screen.
